name: Company Information
description: Provide the basic details of your company / organisation.

name: Contact Details
description: Provide current contact information for your organisation.

name: Banking Details
description: Provide your organisation’s primary banking information.

name: Registration & Statutory
description: Upload all mandatory statutory and registration documents.

name: Director / Shareholder Information
description: List all directors and major shareholders of the company.

name: Business Integrity
description: Answer all integrity questions truthfully. Any YES answer will trigger a compliance review.

name: Sustainable Procurement & ESG
description: Provide information on your environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices.

name: Governance & Compliance
description: Demonstrate your organisation’s governance framework and compliance culture.

name: Trade References
description: Provide at least two trade references from organisations you have supplied in the last three years.

name: Financial Performance
description: Provide audited financial data for the last two financial years.

name: Declaration
description: Read and confirm the declaration before submitting your application.
